candidates.reason: Colour photo (2017) of the harbour mouth with the white North Head dunes, in category Hokianga Harbour; reads as the harbour. Very wide strip (3.2:1) but the dunes sit centre, so a square crop still works.
Same view and quality but 3.1:1, dunes smaller and less central; panorama is the better of the pair.
Omapere wharf ruins; shows a jetty, not the harbour as a whole (check 2); dated tonal grading.
Kohukohu shore and old piles, flat light, only 1024px wide; not the recognisable harbour.
Close view of eroded dune formations; a visitor would not say harbour (check 2).
